claims.quote: Retention interventions require human approval before contacting a customer or changing a contract.

checks.question: Does a support call cause churn?

claims.quote: A model score indicates an estimated association in the available data; it does not prove that a support call caused churn.

checks.question: How do we avoid training data leakage?

claims.quote: Customer identifiers and outcome labels are excluded from model input features. Imputation and encoding are fitted only on training data.

checks.question: How is model ranking quality evaluated?

claims.quote: ROC AUC measures ranking discrimination. Compare the trained model against a baseline and report uncertainty before interpreting model quality.
The model ROC AUC is 0.749 on the synthetic held-out set.

checks.question: Which usage periods supply customer features?

claims.quote: Rows with negative active days, unknown customer references or future usage periods are rejected before feature construction.
Customer usage features use observation periods of November and December 2025. ClientPulse joins this historical usage with customer attributes to predict synthetic churn in the following month.
